headline: Two battle weekends and KvK. Tri-Alliance Clash on Saturday, Swordland on Sunday, then five KvK prep days and the KvK battle on Saturday Dec 5.

goals.title: Full squads for both weekend battles
goals.detail: Tri-Alliance Clash and Swordland Showdown, one hour each. Only confirmed players are registered.

goals.title: Every KvK chest, every day
goals.detail: Spend on each day's theme and open all three daily chests. Saved speedups go in now, not before.

goals.title: Support the lead alliance in KvK
goals.detail: Fill the rallies we are given and hold our turret. Nobody marches on the castle alone.

goals.title: Nobody zeroed, nobody left out
goals.detail: Absentees shielded before 10:00 UTC. All Rescue Orders sent after the battle. Recruits in before Sun Dec 6 23:00 UTC.

goals.title: 40 Championship marches
goals.detail: The minimum is 10. More marches means stronger lanes.

rules: Until Monday Nov 30, hold speedups, Truegold, roulette spins, hero shards, taming marks, forgehammers and widgets. They score far more in KvK prep.
Train troops one tier below your best and keep them for promotions on Thursday Dec 3.
On Sunday Nov 29 leave your intel missions undone. On Monday they count for KvK and Golden Glaives.
Bear Hunt: first-slot hero Chenko, Amadeus or Yeonwoo. Troop mix 10% infantry, 10% cavalry, 80% archers.
Stay in the alliance through Sunday Dec 6, 23:00 UTC, or you miss Alliance Brawl.
Can't play on Saturday Dec 5? Tell the People Officer and shield before 10:00 UTC.

tasks.text: Tell the People Officer today if you can play Saturday, Sunday or both.
Confirm the final Tri-Alliance and Swordland times and lock both rosters with confirmed players only.
Set Championship lanes before each round: two strong lanes, give up the third.
Refresh the Mobilization board on every cooldown; clear speedup and shard missions.
Join the Sanctuary NPC rally when it is called. Finish both days of Mystic Divination missions.
Lead the Sanctuary NPC rally with a full rally, then garrison at once.
Hand out Ruler's chests after a win. Post tomorrow's Tri-Alliance time and roster.
Refresh the Mobilization board on every cooldown.
If you are on the roster, be online 10 minutes before the Clash and stay the full hour.
Caesar's Fury: lock the highest difficulty you can fully clear.
Lead the Clash and appoint Captains. Ask the kingdom's lead alliance what our KvK job is on Dec 5.
Last Mobilization push before it ends.
Be there for the Clash if you can. It is one hour.
Leave today's intel missions undone. Empty your infirmary before Swordland.
Lead Swordland. Hold buildings; do not chase kills.
Summon Caesar's Fury Captains right after Bear Hunt, with a 10-minute warning. Set Tuesday's Viking hour and difficulty.
Schedule the five KvK prep notices for Monday to Friday.
Remove inactive members today, the last calm day before KvK week.
Construction and research speedups, Truegold on buildings, intel missions, charms. Open all three chests.
Use your remaining Caesar's Fury Accords and register for the Championship.
Announce tomorrow's Viking hour and name the HQ garrison leader.
Start chasing Championship registrations.
Hero Roulette spins and hero shards score best today. Send gatherers out. Open all three chests.
Vikings tonight: reinforce online allies with infantry and cavalry, keep archers home, do not heal.
Run Viking Vengeance at the set hour on a difficulty we clear reliably.
Sign up one Sanctuary and one Fortress for Friday. Pick 3 time slots.
Advanced Taming Marks, roulette spins, shards, intel missions. Open all three chests.
At least 10 Championship marches before 23:00 UTC. Start the KvK shield list.
Announce tomorrow's Viking hour.
Train and promote the troops you saved. Widgets, forgehammers, charms. Open all three chests.
Run Viking Vengeance at the set hour.
Set Championship lanes. Agree the Saturday plan with the lead alliance.
Spend everything left. Tonight empty your infirmary.
Lead the Sanctuary rally. Post battle roles for Saturday: rally lead, backup, garrison lead.
Post the shield list.
Schedule Saturday's battle notice for the morning.
Not playing? Shield before 10:00 UTC. Playing? Be in position by 12:00 and follow the War Lead.
At 22:00 open Field Triage and send all 20 Rescue Orders.
09:30: check everyone on the shield list is shielded.
Run our part of the castle fight. Remind chat: heal in small batches.
Be online 12:00–17:00 if you can.
Finish your Rescue Orders. Stay in the alliance past 23:00 UTC.
New recruits in before 23:00 UTC.
Post the Alliance Brawl plan for next week.
Ten minutes with the officers: what went well, what was missed.

notices.title: Roll call
notices.text: Roll call: Tri-Alliance Clash Sat Nov 28 and Swordland Sun Nov 29, one hour each. Reply in chat today: 1 = Saturday, 2 = Sunday, 3 = both. Only confirmed players get a spot.

notices.title: KvK spending freeze
notices.text: KvK prep starts tomorrow. Until then HOLD speedups, Truegold, roulette spins, hero shards, taming marks, forgehammers and widgets. Leave today's intel missions for Monday. Battle: Sat Dec 5, 10:00-22:00 UTC.

notices.title: KvK prep day 1
notices.text: KvK prep day 1: City Construction. Construction and research speedups, Truegold on buildings, intel missions, charms. Gems to finish timers give NO points. Open all 3 daily chests.

notices.title: KvK prep day 2
notices.text: KvK prep day 2: Basic Skills Up. Hero Roulette spins and hero shards score best today. Send gatherers out. Vikings tonight at HH:00 UTC. Open all 3 daily chests.

notices.title: KvK prep day 3
notices.text: KvK prep day 3: Pet Training. Advanced Taming Marks, roulette spins, shards, intel missions. Register for Alliance Championship before 23:00 UTC. Open all 3 daily chests.

notices.title: KvK prep day 4
notices.text: KvK prep day 4: Hero Development. Train and PROMOTE the troops you saved. Use forgehammers, widgets and charms. Vikings tonight at HH:00 UTC. Open all 3 daily chests.

notices.title: KvK prep day 5
notices.text: KvK prep day 5: Power Boost. Spend everything left. Tonight empty your infirmary. Can't play Saturday? Shield before 10:00 UTC Sat, long enough to cover 22:00.

notices.title: KvK battle day
notices.text: KvK battle today 10:00-22:00 UTC. Castle fight 12:00-17:00. Join the rallies the War Lead calls, never attack the castle alone, heal in small batches. At 22:00 open Field Triage and send all 20 Rescue Orders.

notices.title: Viking Vengeance
notices.text: Viking Vengeance at HH:00 UTC. Empty your city: infantry and cavalry reinforce allies who are online, archers stay home. Swap reinforcements 1 hour before. Do not heal during the event.
